selected work.

03 projects · 2025 to 2026

Three builds, three different problems. A camera mount that cannot disturb a rocket in flight. A greenhouse that had to stand up and grow food. A car taken apart system by system and put back better.

01rocket camera mount.

cad design · structures · onshape

An external mount that holds a RunCam 6 camera on the outside of the team rocket, so the flight can be watched back and checked. The hard part is shape: anything that sticks out catches air. The current version is a single low wedge that hugs the body tube, with the lens looking along the tube through a slot in the end wall. Designed and revised in Onshape with the SAME structures team at UW Tacoma.

02greenhouse build.

hands on build · summer 2026

A full season build, June to September 2026. Framing, assembly, and fitting out a working greenhouse, then keeping it running through the summer. Measure, cut, fix, adjust. The kind of work where a problem shows up in real life, not on a screen, and you solve it with the tools and materials in front of you.

  • whenJun to Sep 2026
  • typestructure + fit out
  • workmeasure · build · repair

03automotive systems.

suspension · steering · body

My own car, worked on system by system. Lowering springs fitted, plus headlights, steering wheel, bumper and body components, and wheel spacers. Drill, wrench, screwdriver, socket wrench, and torque wrench, with parts torqued back to spec. It taught me the order real work happens in: understand the system, take it apart cleanly, put it back so it is safe to drive.

about.

the short version

I am a junior studying mechanical engineering at UW Tacoma, and I learn fastest with a part in my hands. Coursework gives me the theory. The rocket team, the greenhouse, and my own car give me the practice.

In labs I have measured, weighed, recorded data, and tested in chemistry and physics. On the rocket team I work under an engineering lead and a sub lead, so my CAD gets checked the way work gets checked in a real shop. Outside engineering I have worked as a lifeguard, on a street crew, and co run a small reselling business since 2022. Different jobs, same habit: show up, do the work properly, finish it.
